message.text:
The compiled React frontend is embedded via `go:embed` and served as static files with SPA fallback. It is wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` and invoked from `server/server.go`.

The mechanism is `go:embed` of the web dist plus Echo static/SPA middleware. The file is `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.

q27.
go:embed of `dist` + Echo static/SPA middleware; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` loads the compiled React build; `Serve` mounts it with `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware`. `server/server.go` calls `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
